hooks.name: Spec sync
hooks.description: Manual: compare the code against requirements.md and design.md of the active spec and list rules that exist in only one of them, plus mismatches.

action.prompt:
Spec sync check. Do not change any code or spec file; report only.
1. Pick the active spec: the spec under .kiro/specs/ whose requirements.md, design.md or tasks.md is open in the editor; if none is open, use the spec whose tasks are most recently completed (tasks.md checkboxes); if still unclear, ask which spec to use.
2. Read that spec's requirements.md (numbered EARS criteria and the Constants table) and design.md (rules, constants, correctness properties).
3. Read the code the spec covers (for dependency-graveyard-core: core/ and the matching tests/). Collect every rule-like behaviour in the code: each function with a `// Requirement N.M` comment, every named constant and its value, every classification or scoring rule, parser/serializer rule, ordering or tie-break rule, and every property-test tag (`Property N`, `Validates: Requirements ...`).
4. Report three lists, each item with file:line and criterion or property number:
   a. In code but not in the spec: behaviour, constant or rule with no matching criterion, or a `Requirement N.M` comment that cites a criterion that does not exist.
   b. In the spec but not in code: criteria with no implementing code, [PBT] criteria with no property test, and design properties with no test tagged with their number.
   c. Mismatches: the code and the spec both have the rule but disagree (different constant value, threshold, ordering, tie-break, or message content).
5. End with a one-line count per list. If all three lists are empty, say so.
